title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → StudentEmployment

source_tables.description: Work-study award (FWS item type) offered and accepted.
Identifies FWS and institutional work-study item types.
HCM job row for the student worker: department, supervisor, hourly rate, standard hours, dates.
Earnings by pay period, summed for FWS earnings to date and YTD.
FA-side tracking of FWS earnings against the award. FLAG: confirm delivered or custom record names.

notes: Student employment spans two PeopleSoft pillars. The award lives in Campus Solutions and the job and pay live in HCM, joined on EMPLID. Only map jobs funded by work-study or classified as student employment; ordinary student hires without aid funding belong in HELIX Employee alone.
privacy: CONFIDENTIAL. This is a FERPA education record; access requires legitimate educational interest (99.31(a)(1)). Pay fields follow HR pay rules (ACM-SPECIAL-011).
